# googleads_campaign_label (Resource)

Attaches a `googleads_label` to a campaign. Both endpoints are immutable per the API; the link has no update operation, so any change forces resource replacement.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `customer_id` (String) Google Ads customer ID.
- `label_id` (String) Resource name of the label. Immutable.
- `parent` (String) Resource name of the campaign. Immutable.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Resource name of the link.
